title: Signal Pads
reference: repeat 7 { forward if tile_is r { turn_left } else { turn_right } }
hints: Every slide ends on a signal pad. Red means turn left, blue means turn right.
Slide, then ask: am I on red? If so turn left, otherwise turn right. Repeat it.
repeat 7 { forward if tile_is r { turn_left } else { turn_right } }
